info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Sales Inquiry API
info.description: The Product Sales Inquiry API facilitates seamless interactions for submitting inquiries related to product sales. It enables businesses to collect and process sales support requests from customers, ensuring that inquiries are addressed efficiently. This API serves as a crucial resource for sales teams and customer support representatives, allowing them to manage customer questions and support needs effectively. Typical consumers of this API include sales departments, e-commerce platforms, and customer service teams seeking to enhance their product sales engagement.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to request assistance with product sales. It is designed to provide support for inquiries related to sales processes, product details, and customer assistance. Ensure that all necessary information is provided in the request to receive timely support.
